source_context.scope: Current installed lighting_v3 solid dielectric smoke/clear host, frozen v5 application and reused v4 shaders, plus completed bounded Stage2 controls. Enables analysis of the planned Stage3 cohorts; does not supply Stage3 numerical or visual acceptance.

stage2_prepared_gate.scope: These authored neutral single-boundary fixtures only; no universal geometry or Stage3/4 acceptance.

stage3_source_model.host: single solid dielectric host containing smoke; not a hollow shell/air cavity
stage3_source_model.scattering: neutral sigma_a=.1, sigma_s=.9, g=0, densityScale=.18; clear only densityScale=0
stage3_source_model.reference: PBRT wavelength jitter enabled; white calibration is source-only, never a hero correction factor
stage3_source_model.geometry: Identical shared closed PLY and fixed camera/film; static source review does not directly read back GPU optical buffers

limits: Actual GPU-uploaded medium IDs, flags, IOR and host state are not read back by this source review; normal completion and full source-frozen image tests remain required.
This is one solid dielectric host containing smoke, not a hollow glass shell with an air cavity.
Shared smooth PLY normals all lie in their geometric hemispheres, but renderer shading-normal transport conventions and finite-precision intersection/offset behavior are not proven identical.

Engine/PBRT density and coefficient multiplication order, majorants, spectral sampling, and estimators differ. Gray optical spectra and scalar eta remove chromatic material mismatch; white-source calibration does not prove the heterogeneous transport implementation.
Depth32 source values match but convergence sufficiency remains the precommitted32-to64 rendered tail test. Source identity is not a claim of identical random samples/variance.
No normal maps/material textures are present. Ray-cone LOD does not select source texture values here, but ray offsets and normal handling still apply.

Old contract unmet text and installation INSTALLED_NOT_RENDERED are preserved historical preparation statements; this report closes only static source checks and confirms existing white-calibration provenance.
The v5 auxiliary meshlet fix applies only to bAirContributor=true pure boundaries. All four Stage3 hosts have false, retaining original loading behavior. Actual Stage2 v5 recovery remains separate.
All formal all-region/channel gates use original protocols; no threshold widening or empirical medium brightness fitting.
Four independent seeds only; SPP checkpoints are dependent. Regional intervals are not simultaneous95% coverage.
Variance PASS means variance decreases with SPP. Engine/PBRT variance equality is not required and is not claimed.

Exact shared-edge repair is bounded: supported coordinate range, edge interior, manifold pair, max8 meshlets/256 triangles and guarded near-hit interval. Vertex/nonmanifold/general subepsilon geometry is not certified.

v4 GPU shader PASS did not prove application integration: actual loader omitted meshlets; failed v4 image evidence remains preserved. v5 changes the auxiliary loader topology, not authored BLAS indices.
Raw GPU meshlet readback was not performed; source/build provenance plus actual repaired image controls establish this scoped integration.
Timing includes differing scopes, concurrent CPU analysis and initialization/post-output shutdown delay. No Stage4 causal overhead or normal-slowdown conclusion.
Stage2 diagnostic visual review waived by user does not approve Stage3 actual RGB images.
Empty unresolved_blocking_issues means no identified blocker for these authored scoped contracts after actual v5 controls, not universal medium/geometry correctness.
Stage2 ratio-normalized neutral controls do not replace Stage3 raw RGB/spectral-noise/32-to64 depth-tail checks.
Source matching does not imply equal variance or identical Monte Carlo samples.
Base/hero/depth execution order may differ; frozen68-image acquisition and statistical definitions are unchanged.

timing_scope: Raw metadata scopes retained verbatim. These cumulative/checkpoint and whole-process records are not a Stage4 isolated slowdown comparison.
statistical_scope: 4independent seeds; marginal95% whole-run CIs; correlated SPP checkpoints; PBRT native spectral noise retained; no fitted intensity or exposure.
known_limitations: Source verification is scoped to the supplied evidence and contracts, not every possible host/air overlap, vertex contact, transform or small interval.
Engineering bands and single-seed hero cannot establish universal unbiasedness.
Conditional scalar reference bands are evaluated from the reference regional mean, per the precommitted definition; no post-image tuning.
